summary.text: Warren Petersen is the Republican nominee, President of the Arizona Senate and a member of the Legislature since first being elected to the House in 2012, according to his campaign site. An attorney and small-business owner from Gilbert, he says he has intervened to defend state laws the current Attorney General declined to defend.

paragraphs.text: Third-generation Gilbert resident with a bachelor's degree and law degree from Arizona State University.
Arizona legislator since first being elected to the House in 2012; Senate President, representing District 14, which covers Gilbert and parts of Queen Creek.
